env_vars.description: List of environment variable overrides; each entry is a key-value pair where value is one of '1', 'yes', or 'true'. Keys must be valid env var names documented by apksigcopier(1). Items are flat key-value objects (see items below).

v1_only.description: Override for --v1-only option: 'yes', 'no', or 'auto'. Also applies as APKSIGCOPIER_V1_ONLY environment variable.

compare_defaults.description: Default options for 'compare' command (used when invoking without explicit flags).
